zh.headline: OpenAI 与 Broadcom 联合发布首款自研推理芯片 "Jalapeño"
zh.observation: 今日最值得关注的信号是**开源模型对闭源巨头的性价比碾压**：GLM-5.2 以 Opus 4.7 五分之一成本接近其性能，直接冲击西方 AI 实验室估值逻辑。同时，**Agent 基础设施正在快速标准化**——从 Qwen-AgentWorld 的环境模拟、OpenThoughts-Agent 的训练配方，到 NVIDIA SkillSpector 的安全扫描、codebase-memory-mcp 的知识图谱索引，一套完整的 Agent 开发工具链正在形成。最后，**推理成本已从技术问题变为商业决策核心**——企业从 Claude 迁移到 DeepSeek 年省数百万美元，OpenAI 自研芯片 Jalapeño 直指推理成本优化，硬件与模型双线降本成为行业主旋律。

items.title: OpenAI 与 Broadcom 联合发布首款自研推理芯片 "Jalapeño"
items.desc: OpenAI 推出与 Broadcom 合作开发的定制 ASIC 芯片，专为 LLM 推理优化，计划于 2026 年底大规模部署。
items.value: 降低推理成本，减少对 NVIDIA 依赖，重塑 AI 芯片格局

items.title: Google 两位顶尖 AI 研究员跳槽 Anthropic

en.headline: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil First Custom Inference Chip "Jalapeño"
en.observation: The most notable signal today is **open-source models' cost-performance crushing closed-source giants**: GLM-5.2 nears Opus 4.7 at one-fifth the cost, directly challenging Western AI lab valuation logic. Meanwhile, **Agent infrastructure is rapidly standardizing**—from Qwen-AgentWorld's environment simulation, OpenThoughts-Agent's training recipes, to NVIDIA SkillSpector's security scanning and codebase-memory-mcp's knowledge graph indexing, a complete agent development toolchain is forming. Finally, **inference cost has shifted from a technical problem to a core business decision**—companies migrating from Claude to DeepSeek save millions annually, OpenAI's self-developed Jalapeño chip targets inference cost optimization directly, making hardware and model dual-line cost reduction the industry's main theme.

items.title: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil First Custom Inference Chip "Jalapeño"
items.desc: OpenAI revealed a custom ASIC chip developed with Broadcom, optimized for LLM inference, with mass deployment planned for late 2026.
items.value: Reduces inference costs, reduces NVIDIA dependency, reshapes AI chip landscape

items.desc: Google DeepMind introduces computer operation abilities to Gemini 3.5 Flash, enabling autonomous desktop environment control.

items.title: Mistral Launches OCR 4: Enterprise Document Intelligence Model
items.desc: Mistral AI releases fourth-gen OCR model with structured output (bounding boxes, block classification, confidence scores), supporting 170 languages.

items.title: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Breaks 30-Second AI Video Generation Barrier
items.desc: ByteDance unveils Seedance 2.5 video model at Volcano Engine FORCE conference, planned for early July launch.
items.value: AI video generation surpasses 30-second threshold, approaching short video content needs

items.title: Grammarly Parent Acquires GPTZero: AI Writing and Detection Merge
items.desc: Superhuman ($4.7B annual revenue) acquires GPTZero ($200M+ annual revenue), integrating AI writing assistance with AI content detection.

items.desc: Anthropic launches Claude Tag, enabling AI task execution via @Claude in Slack; product team generates 65% of code through it.

items.title: Company Migrates from Claude to DeepSeek, Saves Millions Annually
items.desc: An AI company spent 9 months migrating from Claude to DeepSeek, increasing migration workload 100x but saving millions in inference costs yearly.

items.title: Cerebras Stock Plunges After First Post-IPO Earnings

items.value: AI chip company profitability questioned, market grows more cautious on hardware business models

items.title: Qualcomm Acquires Chip Software Startup Modular for Nearly $4 Billion

items.value: Chip software stack becomes battleground for giants, AI hardware ecosystem competition escalates

items.title: OpenAI Codex Found Bombarding SSDs with Needless Writes, Costing Millions
items.desc: Research shows OpenAI Codex generates excessive unnecessary SSD write operations, leading to hardware lifespan reduction and additional costs.
items.value: Hardware side effects of AI inference revealed, optimizing write strategies is urgent

items.title: Zhipu GLM-5.2 Nears Opus 4.7 at One-Fifth Cost in Snowflake Benchmark
items.desc: Snowflake CEO's public test shows GLM-5.2 nearly matches Claude Opus 4.7 on 103 coding tasks at one-fifth the output token cost.

items.title: Agility Robotics Plans SPAC Listing at $2.5B Valuation
items.desc: Humanoid robotics startup Agility Robotics plans to go public via SPAC merger, expecting $620 million in proceeds.

items.title: Qwen-AgentWorld: First Language World Models Simulating Seven Agent Environments
items.desc: Alibaba Qwen team releases Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B and 397B-A17B, the first language world models capable of simulating MCP, terminal, software engineering, Android, Web, and OS environments.
items.value: Provides low-cost environment simulation for agent training, enabling RL without real environments

items.title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Open-Source Data Recipes for Agentic Models
items.desc: Releases a fully open data curation pipeline for training models that generalize across diverse agentic tasks, filling the public agent training data gap.
items.value: Lowers the barrier for agent model training, drives open-source agent ecosystem development

items.title: DFlash Speculative Decoding: Up to 15x Throughput on NVIDIA Blackwell
items.desc: UC San Diego proposes DFlash, replacing autoregressive drafting with a lightweight block diffusion model that generates entire token blocks in a single forward pass.
items.value: New inference acceleration paradigm, supports SGLang/vLLM/TensorRT-LLM, plug-and-play

items.title: NatureBench: Can AI Coding Agents Match Nature Paper SOTA?
items.desc: Proposes 90 cross-discipline tasks to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce cutting-edge results from Nature papers, pushing AI from "reproduction" to "discovery."
items.value: Provides realistic, reproducible evaluation standards for AI research assistants

items.title: Escaping the Self-Confirmation Trap: Execute-Distill-Verify Paradigm for Agent Experience Learning
items.desc: Proposes Execute-Distill-Verify paradigm to solve the problem of wrong-but-self-consistent trajectories being misidentified as successful experiences in single-agent loops.
items.value: Improves reliability of agent experience learning, avoids cumulative errors

items.title: DREAM: Dense Retrieval Embeddings via Autoregressive Modeling
items.desc: Explores whether LLM next-token prediction can provide supervision for dense retrieval without contrastive learning's positive-negative pairs.
items.value: Simplifies retrieval model training pipeline, reduces annotation costs

items.title: DiffusionBench: Holistic Evaluation of Diffusion Transformers
items.desc: Proposes NanoGen framework for systematic evaluation of diffusion transformers under text-to-image generation settings, breaking the single ImageNet class-conditional evaluation paradigm.
items.value: Provides more practical evaluation standards for DiT research

items.title: Prime Intellect Releases prime-rl 0.6.0: RL Training for Trillion-Parameter MoE Models
items.desc: Open-source framework supports asynchronous reinforcement learning on trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models, trained GLM-5 on 28 H200 nodes.
items.value: Open-source RL training framework breaks trillion-parameter scale, lowers barrier for large-scale RL

items.title: OpenMontage: World's First Open-Source Agent Video Production System
items.desc: Features 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills, transforming AI coding assistants into full video production studios.

items.title: NVIDIA SkillSpector: AI Agent Skill Security Scanner
items.desc: Detects vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and security risks in agent skills, ensuring safe agent operation.
items.value: Standardizes agent security scanning, essential for enterprise deployment

items.value: Codebase understanding efficiency leap, more efficient agent context windows

items.title: headroom: Compress Tool Outputs and Logs, Reduce 60-95% Tokens
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before reaching LLM without affecting answer quality. Supports library, proxy, and MCP server modes.

items.title: voicebox: Open-Source AI Voice Studio
